message: 40 election districts with published returns. Alaska publishes House election districts, not borough/census-area county totals. Ranked-choice source counts do not establish a final-round winner. Local sums do not fully reconcile with the statewide snapshot; statewide cards use the separately reported state total. Source times apply to the published race feed; individual local update times are not supplied. Unofficial counts. Counting-progress estimates are labeled separately; no win-probability forecasts are included.
